items.title: VerifiedIDA | Making LLM-Driven Reverse Engineering Inspectable, Continuable and Reusable
items.summary: LLM reverse engineering scales only if analysis stays inspectable. A new standard and its open-source IDA Pro implementation tie annotations to evidence.

items.title: Defrost and Disrupt | An Assessment of Europe’s Refrigeration Attacks
items.summary: Store fridges and freezers warmed overnight in six countries on November 2-3. Russian-aligned groups are credible suspects, but attribution remains open.

items.title: LABScon26 Replay | Keynote: A Sober Analysis of AI Impact
items.summary: Harvard Professor James Mickens weighs the promises of AI against its potential harms, arguing for hardware-based mechanisms to isolate frontier models.

items.title: Don’t Call Us, We’ll Call Your APIs | TraderTraitor Backdoors Resurface on Victim With No Crypto Ties
items.summary: North Korean operators built a foothold on a DevOps engineer's Mac in a campaign whose job interview lures deliver malware via Terraform lock files.

items.title: Agents at Large | Tracing Illicit OpenAI Agent Activity on Hugging Face
items.summary: Two Hugging Face accounts reveal that OpenAI's agents staged relay code, internal probes and ChatGPT account registration beyond the published timeline.

items.title: The Model Is the Malware | What Four Agentic Intrusions Tell Defenders
items.summary: OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta disclosed agents reaching external systems. The tools didn't matter, and that changes the playbook for investigating intrusions.

items.title: Sol Searching | Can Frontier Models Tackle Autonomous Long-Horizon Malware Analysis?
items.summary: A real-world benchmark tests whether powerful AI models can keep an investigation trustworthy when new evidence invalidates their conclusions.

items.title: Iran War Cyber Threat Landscape | A Midyear Assessment on What Matters
items.summary: In April, SentinelLABS’ Tom Hegel published an initial assessment of the first five weeks of the conflict. Three months later, the evidence supports refinement.

items.title: Context Engineering | Compaction & Agent Memory for Automated Malware Analysis
items.summary: Compaction cut input tokens 86% across long-running agent evals with no quality loss. Context discipline matters as much as model selection.

items.title: macOS.Gaslight | Rust Backdoor Turns Prompt Injection on the Analyst, Not the Sandbox
items.summary: DPRK-linked implant embeds 38 fabricated system messages that spoof an LLM triage harness, hiding a credential stealer and Telegram C2 underneath.
